hooks.command: if [ ! -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/index.js" ]; then cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" && npm install --silent && npm run build >&2; fi; echo '{}'

d="${HARMONY_HOME:-$HOME/.harmony}/conduct-sessions"; mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null; i=$(cat 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n' | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); if [ -n "$i" ]; then printf '%s' "$i" > "$d/current-session"; fi; find "$d" -type f -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Harmony conduct-session id: %s. A session that drives a Harmony ticket writes its conduct breadcrumb at %s/%s.json (see the harmony-conduct skill)."}}' "$i" "$d" "$i"
